design_philosophy.description: A high-density, transactional interface prioritizing information hierarchy and conversion over decorative flair. mimics the visual language of Amazon's 'Ember' design system.

rules: Use text-[13px] or text-sm for standard body text.
Use text-xs for secondary metadata (review counts, technical specs).
Headings should be bold and concise.
Price text must be distinct (e.g., text-lg or text-xl for main price, text-red-700/80).

global_nav.structure: Full-width, dark background (#131921). Logo left, Search center (white input, orange search button), Cart/Account right.
global_nav.sub_nav: Full-width, lighter dark background (#232f3e). List of links.

shop_page.structure: Sidebar (left) for filters + Main Grid (right) for products.
shop_page.card_style: Border-gray-200 rounded-none or rounded-sm, vertical stack.

product_detail.structure: Two-column layout on desktop (Left: Image, Right: Details). Max-width container.
product_detail.image_section: Sticky on desktop. 'No Image' placeholder: Aspect ratio square, bg-gray-100, centered gray icon.
product_detail.info_section: Vertical stack: Title > Brand > Rating > Price > Description > Actions.

recommendation_tray.title: Frequently bought together
recommendation_tray.structure: Horizontal scrolling list or flex-wrap row.
recommendation_tray.card_density: Compact. Thumbnail + Title + Price + Add Button.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFD814] hover:bg-[#F7CA00] text-black border border-[#FCD200] rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 border border-[#D5D9D9] text-black rounded-lg px-4 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm

inputs.standard: rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-[#e77600] focus:ring focus:ring-[#e77600] focus:ring-opacity-50

cards.product: bg-white border border-gray-200 p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex flex-col h-full
cards.recommendation: w-40 flex-shrink-0 border border-gray-200 p-2 bg-white

badges.best_seller: bg-[#C45500] text-white text-xs px-2 py-0.5 font-bold skew-x-[-10deg] inline-block
badges.discount: bg-[#CC0C39] text-white text-xs px-1 py-0.5 rounded-sm

components.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Size 16px-20px generally. Star icon for ratings.

interaction_guidelines.hover_states: Links underline on hover. Cards slightly darken or show border change.
interaction_guidelines.feedback: Show loading spinners on async actions (recommendation fetch).

functionality_specs.recommendation_logic: Clicking a recommendation card must update the URL (?item_id=...) and re-render the detail view.
functionality_specs.images: Use styled 'No image available' placeholders using div and lucide-react ImageOff icon.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Shadcn components but OVERRIDE styles to match Amazon colors (Yellow buttons, etc).
2. Create a 'Layout' component that includes the dark Header and Subheader.
3. Use standard <a> tags or React Router <Link> with #007185 color for text links.
4. Ensure the backend endpoint /api/recommendations/{item_id} is called when a product is viewed.
5. Use 'lucide-react' for icons (Search, ShoppingCart, Star, Menu, X).
6. Do NOT use rounded-xl or large shadows. Keep it rectangular and crisp.
7. Implement the 'Frequently bought together' section as a distinct visual block below the main product details.
8. Ensure all prices use the createCurrencyFormatter helper (vi-VN).
9. Add data-testid to every interactive element for testing.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds.
Do not center text by default; Left-align is standard for this design.
Ensure the app is responsive (stack columns on mobile).
